data.gender_notes: Bimlesh is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Bimlesh signifies the embodiment of God's wish or divine desire. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'bim' meaning 'wish' and 'lesh' meaning 'embodiment'. This name symbolizes the fulfillment of desires and the realization of spiritual goals. The name Bimlesh carries the meaning “Embodiment of God's wish” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bimlesh usually hope their child will grow to embody embodiment of god's wish and live with faith, good character and purpose.
